candidates.rationale: A single seasonal route whose calendar ended 2025-10-13. Worth separating publisher inactivity from seasonality here: the file was last modified 2026-02-27, so the publisher is active and simply has not posted the current season under this URL. At 3.7 KB it is small enough to be one ferry run. The state's main transit operator is separately registered and does not carry this service. Re-check after the season it covers.
